+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_context_full_round_is_reported_not_continued(
+    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
+) -> None:
+    """A full input context ends the round with a notice instead of a futile continuation."""
+    client = _ScriptedChatClient(
+        [
+            [_llm_chunk(content="Partial answer", finish_reason="context_length_exceeded")],
+            [_llm_chunk(content=" and a continuation that must never be requested.")],
+        ]
+    )
+    pipeline = AgenticChatPipeline(language="en")
+    pipeline.registry = _Registry()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(pipeline, "_compose_enabled_tools", lambda _context: [])
+    monkeypatch.setattr(pipeline, "_build_openai_client", lambda: client)
+
+    events = await _run(pipeline, UnifiedContext(session_id="s1", user_message="explain"))
+
+    assert client.call_count == 1
+    warnings = [
+        str(event.content)
+        for event in events
+        if (event.metadata or {}).get("trace_kind") == "warning"
+    ]
+    assert any("context window" in text for text in warnings)
+    assert _answer_text(events) == "Partial answer"
+

+def _response(stop_reason: str) -> Any:
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        content=[SimpleNamespace(type="text", text="partial")],
+        stop_reason=stop_reason,
+        usage=None,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("stop_reason", "expected"),
+    [
+        ("end_turn", "stop"),
+        ("stop_sequence", "stop"),
+        ("tool_use", "tool_calls"),
+        ("max_tokens", "length"),
+        ("model_context_window_exceeded", "context_length_exceeded"),
+        ("refusal", "content_filter"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_stop_reason_is_mapped_to_canonical_finish_reason(stop_reason: str, expected: str) -> None:
+    result = AnthropicProvider._parse_response(_response(stop_reason))
+    assert result.finish_reason == expected
+
+
+def test_context_window_exceeded_is_not_an_output_truncation() -> None:
+    """A full input context must not drive the "continue the answer" recovery."""
+    from deeptutor.services.llm import finish_was_truncated
+
+    result = AnthropicProvider._parse_response(_response("model_context_window_exceeded"))
+    assert not finish_was_truncated(result.finish_reason)
